lead: Artificial intelligence can speed up work with information and take some routine tasks off your hands. I help you find a specific use for it in your business — one that makes work easier rather than adding another tool.

sections.heading: AI for time-consuming tasks
sections.text: AI can help draft a message, summarise a long document, organise content or extract information from documents. These are examples of possible uses, not a ready-made package for every business. We choose them around the challenges your team faces each day.

sections.heading: The need comes before the tool
sections.text: I start by identifying repetitive work with text or data and deciding what is worth improving. Then I choose how to use AI and fit it into the existing process. This makes it clear which problem we are solving and when the team can use the new tool.

sections.heading: People stay in control
sections.text: AI can suggest, organise and prepare material, but the result needs to meet your business needs. We agree on which information can be processed, how to check responses and which decisions still need your expertise. I design the solution around security principles and the way your team works.
